title: Coherent tensor family on the published signed Tate sheaves
statement: For N positive and invertible on T and A annihilated by N, construct an integer tensor family whose objects are exactly finiteEtaleTateSheaf A N T hA a. Its product has the stated unitors, positive successor identity, evaluation and symmetry. All integer degrees trivialize on the same primitive-root etale cover.

source.place: Tag 03PK; finite Tate line and tensor powers. Categorical coherence is proved from the existing source integer tensor family and pullback adjunction APIs.

from.place: Construction of the root cover, scalar extension and signed tensor comparisons

proof.text: Use the local line trivialization and the existing tensorInverseOfUpperStarIso construction to obtain the internal dual as a genuine tensor inverse. Form its normalized signed family.

Use the published positive twists directly as the natural-number family in the normalized construction. Its signed objects are definitionally the published finiteEtaleTateSheaf, so the zero, positive-successor and evaluation equations apply directly.

On the same root cover compare the mapped family with the constant unit family using the degree-one trivialization. Transport through overSheafEquiv to obtain the precise localized-site trivializations. For symmetry use the single surjective etale trivialization; its pullback is faithful and braided, so the general tensor-family commutativity lemma applies.

theorem finiteEtaleTateTensorFamily_comm (a b : ℤ) :
    (β_ (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA a) (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA b)).hom ≫
      ((finiteEtaleTateTensorFamily T m hm A hA hT).addIso b a).hom ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA) (add_comm b a)) =
        ((finiteEtaleTateTensorFamily T m hm A hA hT).addIso a b).hom
